form.label: Network Traffic Analysis
form.description: Network visibility, traffic anomalies, and firewall monitoring

search.query: index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats sum(orig_bytes) as out, sum(resp_bytes) as in | eval total_GB=round((out+in)/1024/1024/1024, 2) | fields total_GB
index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats count by proto | sort -count

index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn duration>300 | stats count as conn_count, avg(duration) as avg_duration, sum(orig_bytes) as bytes_out by id.orig_h, id.resp_h, id.resp_p | eval avg_duration_min=round(avg_duration/60, 1) | eval bytes_out_MB=round(bytes_out/1024/1024, 2) | sort -avg_duration | rename id.orig_h as "Source IP", id.resp_h as "Dest IP", id.resp_p as "Dest Port", conn_count as "Count", avg_duration_min as "Avg Duration (min)", bytes_out_MB as "Data Out (MB)" | head 30

(index=network sourcetype=zeek:dns) OR (index=network sourcetype=technitium:syslog) OR (index=linux sourcetype=technitium:querylog) | stats count as queries, dc(query) as unique_domains by src_ip | sort -queries | rename src_ip as "Source IP", queries as "Total Queries", unique_domains as "Unique Domains" | head 30
index=network sourcetype=zeek:dns rcode_name=NXDOMAIN | timechart span=5m count by src_ip limit=10

index=linux sourcetype=iptables | stats count as blocks, values(dest_port) as target_ports by src_ip, ipt_chain | sort -blocks | rename src_ip as "Blocked Source", ipt_chain as "Firewall Chain", blocks as "Block Count", target_ports as "Attempted Ports" | head 30
index=linux sourcetype=iptables | timechart span=5m count by ipt_chain

index=network sourcetype=zeek:http | where user_agent IN ("curl", "wget", "python-requests", "Go-http-client", "Invoke-WebRequest") OR method IN ("PUT", "DELETE") OR status_code >= 400 | table _time, id.orig_h, id.resp_h, method, host, uri, user_agent, status_code | sort -_time | rename id.orig_h as "Source", id.resp_h as "Server", method as "Method", host as "Host", uri as "URI", user_agent as "User-Agent", status_code as "Status" | head 50

index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats dc(id.resp_p) as unique_ports, values(id.resp_p) as port_list by id.orig_h, id.resp_h | where unique_ports > 10 | sort -unique_ports | rename id.orig_h as "Scanner IP", id.resp_h as "Target IP", unique_ports as "Unique Ports", port_list as "Ports Scanned" | head 30
